## Introduction

Probabilistic Code using the parquet files for the base of the analysis.

## Read in the files

Using the updated BWAM analytics file for prep. Read in the parquet file first and load libraries

```{r message=FALSE}
library(arrow)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(spsurvey)
library(dplyr)

# Directories
obt_result_dir <- file.path(
  "L:",
  "DOW",
  "BWAM Share",
  "data",
  "parquet",
  "analytical_table_store",
  "obt_result.parquet"
)


```

Then we'll load in the weights from the workup that was previous to this. this is the last 3 cycles - so 2008, 2013 and 2018

```{r read-in-files, message = FALSE}
#read in the adjusted weights from the original workup-harvesting-COMID-wgt_11_9_22.R
wgts<-readr::read_csv("outputs/prob_site_adj_wgt_kar.csv")

#fixing ID's 


#clean up, lots of extra columns
wgts<-wgts %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(
  PREVIOUS_SAMPLE_DATE_1,
  PREVIOUS_SAMPLE_DATE_2, 
  PREVIOUS_SAMPLE_DATE_3,
  PREVIOUS_SAMPLE_DATE_4, 
  PREVIOUS_SAMPLE_DATE_5, 
  PREVIOUS_SAMPLE_DATE_6, 
  PREVIOUS_SAMPLE_DATE_7
  ))

wgts<-wgts %>% 
  mutate(SMAS_ID = case_when(
    SMAS_ID %in% "05-CAMP- 1.5"~"05-CAMB-1.5",
    SMAS_ID %in% '05-COHO-4.0'~'05-COHO-3.9',
    SMAS_ID %in% '05-MEAD-10.8'~'05-MEAD-10.9',
    SMAS_ID %in% '08-BLCK_T58-2.0'~'08-BLCK_T79-2.0',
    SMAS_ID %in% '08-LIME-6.3'~"08-LMKN-6.7",
    SMAS_ID %in% '13-TIOR-0.2'~'13-TIOR-0.1',
    SMAS_ID %in% '07-LIME-13'~'07-LIME-13.0',
    SMAS_ID %in% '04-MCMI_S-5'~'04-MCMI_S-5.0',
    SMAS_ID %in% '4-CRYD-2.3'~'04-CRYD-2.3',
    SMAS_ID %in% '4-WIGW-0.7'~'04-WIGW-0.7',
    SMAS_ID %in% '9-LITL-3.5'~'09-LITL-3.5',
    SMAS_ID %in% '9-REGI-7.8'~'09-REGI-7.8',
    SMAS_ID %in% '9-SCKE-8.3'~'09-SCKE-8.3',
    SMAS_ID %in% '9-WSCK-3.4'~'09-WSCK-3.4',
    SMAS_ID %in% "05-CRAN-0.1"~ "05-CRBP-0.1",
    SMAS_ID %in% "08-BENE-0.6"~ "08-BENE-0.8",
    SMAS_ID %in% "06-BIBS-6.6"~ "06-JENC-6.6",
    SMAS_ID %in% "11-UHUD-98.3"~ "11-UHUD-98.7",
    TRUE ~ SMAS_ID
  ))

sites.l<-unique(wgts$SMAS_ID) #creating a list of the unique stream sites
#rename to site_code
wgts$SITE_CODE <- wgts$SMAS_ID
```

Then we can merge with parquet files, by doing some filtering and merging

```{r collect-parquet-file}
# All stream data from the sites Id'd as probabilistic
stream_df <- open_dataset(obt_result_dir) |> 
  filter(WATERBODY_TYPE %in% "river_stream",
         SITE_CODE %in% sites.l) |> 
  collect() 

missing<-anti_join(
  wgts,
  stream_df,
  by = "SITE_CODE"
)

#there are 11 sites that did not match, these might be site name changes from teh parquet file? Need to check these

```

```{r merge-with-weights}
#create a merge field with year and site for the wgts
stream_df_merge<-stream_df %>% 
  mutate(year = lubridate::year(EVENT_DATETIME),
         matching = paste(SITE_CODE,year,sep = "_"))

wgts<-wgts %>% 
  mutate(matching = paste(SITE_CODE,YEAR,sep = "_"))

#inner join since we dont want the unmatched

stream_df_merged<-merge(stream_df_merge,wgts,
                           c("matching","SITE_CODE"))

#write to RDS to use in other scripts
write_rds(stream_df_merged,"outputs/Probabilistic_data_workup_2_6_25.rds")


#look at the ones that didnt match
non_matches<-anti_join(
  wgts,
  stream_df_merge,
  by = c("matching","SITE_CODE")
)
#write.csv(non_matches, "outputs/prob_matching_fix.csv")

#fix the ones that didnt match, read in the file that I tracked 
#some were problems with id, others didnt match w/the year sampled. these fixes are incorporated up above in the code - read-in-files

```

Now, we can do some fun things! the column "start" is the draw year, so I updated that here for clarity.

Statewide BAP stuff

```{r fun-coding-BAP, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

stream_df_merged$draw_year<-stream_df_merged$start

stream_df_merged<-stream_df_merged %>% 
  dplyr::rename(latitude = LATITUDE,
         longitude = LONGITUDE) |> 
  mutate(adj_wgt_all = adj_wgt/3)

#filter the data
metrics.sf<-stream_df_merged %>% 
  filter(PARAMETER_NAME %in% "bap_biological_assessment_profile") %>% 
  mutate(standard_cat = case_when(RESULT_VALUE >= 7.5 ~ "Non-Impacted",
                                  RESULT_VALUE >=5 & RESULT_VALUE < 7.5~"Slightly Impacted",
                                  RESULT_VALUE < 5& RESULT_VALUE >=2.5~"Moderately Impacted",
                                  RESULT_VALUE <2.5~"Severly Impacted",
                                  TRUE ~ "error")) %>% 
  filter(adj_wgt >0)

#create sf object
metrics.sf <- sf::st_as_sf(metrics.sf,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"
)

#run the spsurvey data
standard_ests<-spsurvey::cat_analysis(
  dframe = metrics.sf,
  vars = "standard_cat",
  siteID = "SITE_CODE",
  weight = "adj_wgt",
  subpops = "draw_year"
)

standard_ests<-standard_ests %>% 
  filter(Category != "Total")


plot<-ggplot2::ggplot(standard_ests, aes(x=factor(standard_ests$Subpopulation), y=standard_ests$Estimate.P)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity",aes(fill=standard_ests$Subpopulation)) +
  geom_crossbar( aes(x=factor(standard_ests$Subpopulation), y=standard_ests$Estimate.P, ymin=standard_ests$LCB95Pct.P, ymax=standard_ests$UCB95Pct.P), colour="grey", alpha=0.5, size=0.5, fill = "grey")+
  # ggpattern::geom_crossbar_pattern( aes(x=factor(chloride_ests$Category), y=chloride_ests$Estimate.P, ymin=chloride_ests$LCB95Pct.P, ymax=chloride_ests$UCB95Pct.P), size = 0.5)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin= standard_ests$LCB95Pct.P,
                    ymax= standard_ests$UCB95Pct.P),
                width=.2,                    # Width of the error bars
                position="identity",
                alpha = 0.5)+
  coord_flip()+ggtitle(label = "BAP Categories")+
  labs(fill = "Draw Year")

plot+facet_wrap(~Category) + ylab("% of Total stream Miles")+xlab("Probabilistic Cycle Year")


plot2<-ggplot2::ggplot(metrics.sf,
                      aes(x=as.factor(draw_year), y = RESULT_VALUE)) + 
    geom_boxplot(fill="slateblue", alpha=0.2) + 
    xlab("Draw Year")

plot2

standard_ests_bap<-spsurvey::cont_analysis(
  dframe = metrics.sf,
  vars = "RESULT_VALUE",
  siteID = "SITE_CODE",
  weight = "adj_wgt_all"
  # subpops = "SO"
)

plot(standard_ests_bap$CDF)
```

```{r some more fun BAP things}

#filter the data
metrics.sf_pma<-stream_df_merged %>% 
  filter(PARAMETER_NAME %in% "percent_model_affinity" ) %>% 
  mutate(standard_cat = case_when(RESULT_VALUE >= 64 ~ "Non-Impacted",
                                  RESULT_VALUE >=49 & RESULT_VALUE < 64~"Slightly Impacted",
                                  RESULT_VALUE >=35& RESULT_VALUE <=49~"Moderately Impacted",
                                  RESULT_VALUE <35~"Severly Impacted",
                                  TRUE ~ "error")) %>% 
  filter(adj_wgt >0) |> 
  mutate(adj_wgt_all = adj_wgt/3) |> 
  mutate(SO = case_when(SO >=4 ~ 4,
                        TRUE ~ SO))

#thinking about nitrogen stuff
  # mutate(standard_cat = case_when(RESULT_VALUE >= 482 ~ "Poor",
  #                                 RESULT_VALUE >345 & RESULT_VALUE <= 482~"Fair",
  #                                 RESULT_VALUE < 345& RESULT_VALUE >= 0 ~"Good",
  #                                 TRUE ~ "error"))


#create sf object
metrics.sf_pma <- sf::st_as_sf(metrics.sf_pma,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"
)

#run the spsurvey data
standard_ests<-spsurvey::cat_analysis(
  dframe = metrics.sf_pma,
  vars = "standard_cat",
  siteID = "SITE_CODE",
  weight = "adj_wgt_all",
  subpops = "SO"
)

standard_ests<-standard_ests %>% 
  filter(Category != "Total") |> 
  filter(Subpopulation != 0)


plot<-ggplot2::ggplot(standard_ests, aes(x=factor(standard_ests$Subpopulation), y=standard_ests$Estimate.P)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity",aes(fill=standard_ests$Subpopulation)) +
  geom_crossbar( aes(x=factor(standard_ests$Subpopulation), y=standard_ests$Estimate.P, ymin=standard_ests$LCB95Pct.P, ymax=standard_ests$UCB95Pct.P), colour="grey", alpha=0.5, size=0.5, fill = "grey")+
  # ggpattern::geom_crossbar_pattern( aes(x=factor(chloride_ests$Category), y=chloride_ests$Estimate.P, ymin=chloride_ests$LCB95Pct.P, ymax=chloride_ests$UCB95Pct.P), size = 0.5)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin= standard_ests$LCB95Pct.P,
                    ymax= standard_ests$UCB95Pct.P),
                width=.2,                    # Width of the error bars
                position="identity",
                alpha = 0.5)+
  coord_flip()+ggtitle(label = "PMA Categories")+
  labs(fill = "SO")

plot+facet_wrap(~Category) + ylab("% of Total stream Miles")+xlab("Strahler Order")

standard_ests<-spsurvey::cont_analysis(
  dframe = metrics.sf_pma,
  vars = "RESULT_VALUE",
  siteID = "SITE_CODE",
  weight = "adj_wgt_all"
  # subpops = "SO"
)

plot(standard_ests$CDF)
```

#looking at the userp stuff

```{r}
#filter the data
user.sf<-stream_df_merged %>% 
  filter(PARAMETER_NAME %in% c("primary_variable")) |> 
  filter(adj_wgt > 0) |> 
  mutate(standard_cat1 = sub(",.*", "", RESULT_CATEGORY)) |> 
  mutate(standard_cat = case_when(
    standard_cat1 %in% "Water Clarity" | standard_cat1 %in% "Water_Clarity"~ "clarity",
    standard_cat1 %in% "Periphyton" ~ "periphyton",
    standard_cat1 %in% "Odor" ~ "odor",
    standard_cat1 %in% "Trash" ~ "trash",
    standard_cat1 %in% "Macrophyte" ~ "macrophyte",
    standard_cat1 %in% "Proximity to Development Roads" |
      standard_cat1 %in% "Proximity to Development Buildings" ~ "proximity to development",
    TRUE ~ "other"
    
  ))


#create sf object
user.sf <- sf::st_as_sf(user.sf,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"
)
```

```{r results='asis', continuous}
for (i in 1:nparams){
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
#ok we got em all now :)

  mutate(parameter = paste(PARAMETER_NAME,UNIT,sep = "_")) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(parameter %in% params[i]) %>% 
  distinct()

probDF_filter<-probDF %>% 
  dplyr::filter(parameter %in% params[i]) %>% 
  distinct()

upper_y_limit<-max((max(p_all$RESULT_VALUE,na.rm = TRUE)+
                      0.05*max(p_all$RESULT_VALUE, na.rm = TRUE)),.15)
avg = mean(p_all$RESULT_VALUE,na.rm = TRUE)

plot<-(ggplot(probDF_filter,aes(x=results,y=probability))+
       geom_line()+
       geom_area(colour="black", fill="#808080", alpha=.2)+
       scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,upper_y_limit))+                                 #creates y limit to match above
       ylab(paste("statewide %",params[i],sep = " "))+
       geom_vline(xintercept = avg)+                                                    #creates intercept of avg vs statewide %
       theme(#axis.text.x=element_blank(), #remove x axis labels
             #axis.ticks.x=element_blank(), #remove x axis ticks
             # axis.title.x=element_blank(),
             axis.title.x=element_text(size=8, vjust = 8),                              #sets size and location of axis title

            # panel.background = element_blank(),
            # axis.line = element_blank(),
             plot.margin=unit(c(-.55,0,-.15,0),"cm"))+              #controls stretch of statewide % to be equal to the length of plots
       coord_flip())+
  ggtitle(params[i])

knitr::knit_print(plot)
}
```

```{r}
basin <- sf::read_sf("L:/DOW/BWAM Share/SMAS/data/archive/map_files/basin_big.shp") 
metrics.sf$Year<-as.character(metrics.sf$draw_year)

sf::st_crs(basin)

basin_shp<-st_crs("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs")

basin_shp<-sf::st_as_sf(basin)
states <- sf::st_as_sf(maps::map("state",
                           plot = FALSE,
                           fill = TRUE))

nys <- states %>%
  filter(ID == "new york")

# get bounding for the outline this is for the inset map, to make it have a border
outline.df <- ggplot2::fortify(nys)
nybox <- sf::st_as_sfc(sf::st_bbox(outline.df))

# make some bbox magic to give it a little border
bbox_new <- st_bbox(nybox) # current bounding box

xrange <- bbox_new$xmax - bbox_new$xmin # range of x values
yrange <- bbox_new$ymax - bbox_new$ymin # range of y values

# bbox_new[1] <- bbox_new[1] - (0.25 * xrange) # xmin - left
bbox_new[3] <- bbox_new[3] + (0.4 * xrange) # xmax - right
# bbox_new[2] <- bbox_new[2] - (0.25 * yrange) # ymin - bottom
bbox_new[4] <- bbox_new[4] + (0.2 * yrange) # ymax - top

bbox_new <- bbox_new %>% # take the bounding box ...
  st_as_sfc() # ... and make it a sf polygon
# checking SSL


basin_map <- tmap::tm_basemap(c(
  StreetMap = "OpenStreetMap",
  TopoMap = "OpenTopoMap"
)) +
  # tmap_options(check.and.fix = TRUE) +
  # tmap::tm_shape(nys, bbox = bbox_new) +
  # tmap::tm_fill() +
  tmap::tm_shape(basin_shp,
    bbox = bbox_new
  ) +
  tmap::tm_fill(col = "white", alpha = .9) +
  tmap::tm_borders() +
  tmap::tm_shape(metrics.sf)+
  tmap::tm_dots(
          shape = "Year",
          title = "BAP Categories",
          size = 0.2,
          pallete = "brewer.greens")+
          #colorNA = "green",   # <-------- color for NA values)+
  tmap::tm_scale_bar(position = c("left", "bottom")) +
  tmap::tm_compass(position = c("left", "top")) +
  tmap::tm_layout(
    title = "Statewide Macroinvertebrates",
    legend.position = c("right", "top"),
    bg.color = "grey85"
  ) +
  tmap::tm_credits("Data source:2008-2021 ",
    fontface = "italic",
    align = "right"
  ) +
  tmap::tm_credits("Author: SMAS ",
    fontface = "bold",
    align = "right"
  )
basin_map
```
